policy: Production reads these artifacts ONLY through pipeline.lib.calibration_assets.asset_path, which verifies the sha256 below. Refreshing an artifact is a deliberate act: replace the file, update this manifest, commit both together. A lab rerun that rewrites notebook outputs cannot change production.

peru_ladder_full.parquet.role: Peru release-cycle nowcast ladder (all members, all origins); the official Adaptive-IC combination and the exact-chain replay build on it

peru_s1_day1.parquet.role: legacy S1 conditional-BVAR backtest at day-1 information state; prior pool for sequential fan calibration

peru_s1_day30.parquet.role: legacy S1 conditional-BVAR backtest at day-30 information state; prior pool for sequential fan calibration

china_ladder_full.parquet.role: China release-cycle nowcast ladder; Adaptive-IC weights for the satellite nowcast

china_horizon_2012floor.parquet.role: China forecast horse-race backtest; Combo weights (PAST bases only; the live base is always recomputed) and TPN error calibration

china_tilt_weo.parquet.role: WEO-tilted China path backtest; the published path blends Combo and tilt with weight ALPHA
